description: This file defines the LogView class, a custom Android TextView for displaying log data. It implements the LogNode interface to format and output log messages received from other components, supporting chaining of log nodes.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView that displays log messages received via the LogNode interface, formatting log data and appending it to the view.

methods.name: LogView
methods.description: Constructors for LogView, initializing with context, with or without attribute set and style.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats and outputs a log message, converting priority to string, handling exceptions, and ensuring UI thread execution. Also passes the log to the next node if chained.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendIfNotNull
methods.description: Helper method that appends a string to a StringBuilder with a delimiter if the string is not null or empty.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends a string as a new line in the LogView display.
